title: Feature work stays sequence-scoped
user_prompt: We are producing a 100 minute feature. SEQ-006 is current. Tell me what project context you should load first and whether you should load the entire film state.

title: Missing coverage blocks generation
user_prompt: SEQ-003 has two audible LINE records with no voice cues. Can I mark the sequence ready for generation?

title: Long-range continuity uses explicit evidence
user_prompt: A scar introduced in SEQ-002 returns in SEQ-010. What durable record should connect the two sequences?

title: VRAM over-budget is not hand-waved
user_prompt: The declared video profile needs 28 GiB VRAM but the usable machine limit is 23 GiB. What should happen?

title: Reboot uses durable checkpoint
user_prompt: The PC rebooted in the middle of a feature project. Should you reconstruct progress from our old chat?

title: Partial batch keeps completed jobs
user_prompt: JOB-001 through JOB-020 completed. JOB-021 failed. What should a recovery batch do with JOB-001 through JOB-020?

title: Timeline missing selected shot blocks reconciliation
user_prompt: SHOT-144 has an approved selected take but it is absent from the main film timeline. Is reconciliation ready?

title: Master file alone does not prove completion
user_prompt: film_master.mp4 exists, but two sequences are blocked and delivery QC failed. Is the feature complete?

title: Resource handoff makes no creative changes without LLM
user_prompt: The local LLM is unloaded and a ComfyUI job fails because the prompt needs a semantic rewrite. What can the model-free runner do?

title: Rich document needs Markdown companion
user_prompt: You created festival_packet.pdf. What other file must exist beside it?

title: Health report is not artistic judgment
user_prompt: The production health report says healthy. Does that prove the acting and story are excellent?

title: Final feature gate
user_prompt: Before I call my feature finished, name the deterministic feature-scale checks that should be green.
